clue.text: Do not start to take for granted at restart

indicators.note: tells us to drop the opening letter of the word for taking for granted

parts.note: to presume something is to take it for granted

explanation.surface: Advice not to make assumptions when beginning again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do not start' removes the first letter, P, from PRESUME.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up again after a break is a synonym for restarting an activity.

clue.text: Managed police department, though gone bad!

parts.note: to run something is to manage it, so ran is managed
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: A police unit was in charge but things have soured.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoiled butter or oil smells sour and stale, an adjective for food turned bad.

definitions.meaning: elastic is a thing that stretches, read whimsically as something stretching
a frame or litter for carrying injured people

explanation.walkthrough: 'Elastic' is an extender of things, cryptically a thing that stretches.
explanation.definitionFit: A litter for casualties, and anything that extends things, both take this noun.

indicators.note: says the letters are found passing through the town name Amiens

explanation.definitionFit: Someone's air, demeanour or manner is a synonym for bearing.

clue.text: Sudden movement of the leading sorceress

indicators.note: leading means the front letter of the word the

explanation.surface: A spell-caster at the head of a coven makes a quick gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: A jerk or spasm of a muscle is a synonym for a sudden small movement.

parts.note: with means alongside or together with
crimson is a shade of red

explanation.definitionFit: Plants that have shrivelled and dried up have faded away.

indicators.note: seen in says the letters show up inside the island name Santorini

explanation.surface: A rocky outcrop spotted on a Greek island.

clue.text: Protective cover — the exotic tree's inside

exotic means the letters of the are made strange, rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' makes HET; the 's of tree's reads as 'is', so the tree is inside rather than possessing an interior.
explanation.definitionFit: Headgear worn to guard the skull is a kind of protective cover.

explanation.surface: A remark that something belongs to neither side, nor the smaller group.
explanation.definitionFit: The conjunction paired with neither, standing in for it in a sense of 'and not'.

explanation.walkthrough: 'making' rearranges SPOT CAMEL. The medium is a spiritualist, not a size.

indicators.note: in part says the letters form a portion of the word badminton

explanation.surface: Someone is partly enthusiastic about a shuttlecock game.
explanation.definitionFit: Being keen on a hobby is informally being 'into' it, an idiom for enthusiasm.

clue.text: The least expensive accommodation in the main

definitions.text: The least expensive accommodation in the main

parts.words: The least expensive accommodation in the main
parts.note: the main is a poetic word for the sea, so this is the cheapest berth on a ship

explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' looks like 'mostly' but means the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The cheapest passenger class on an ocean liner, below decks near the rudder gear.

indicators.note: off means the letters of scare go wrong, rearranged

explanation.surface: Some women frighten away a smug continental.
explanation.definitionFit: A smart aleck who thinks themselves clever is a know-all.

parts.note: Hair is the famous 1960s rock musical

explanation.surface: A bit of a stage show offering a fake disguise.

clue.text: Swirling raven likes first of spring

first means the front letter of the word likes

explanation.surface: A circling raven enjoys the start of spring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swirling' turns RAVEN into VERNA; 'first' adds L from 'likes'.
explanation.definitionFit: This adjective describes anything relating to or occurring in the springtime.

clue.text: Foreign mountain race disturbed by isolated detective

explanation.definitionFit: The TV sleuth worked on an island, and islands are cut off, so isolated.

indicators.note: they say means we take the word as heard rather than written

clue.text: Tardy person, surprisingly clear to me

indicators.note: surprisingly means the letters come out in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that the slow arrival is, astonishingly, obvious to them.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who arrives after the start is a late arrival, a tardy person.

clue.text: Roman gown without a warmth rating

indicators.note: without means the letter a is removed from the gown

parts.note: a toga is a Roman gown

explanation.surface: A Roman garment lacking any warmth rating.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a tog is the unit rating the warmth of duvets and quilts.
explanation.definitionFit: The unit for thermal insulation of bedding, so a measure of warmth.

indicators.note: in says the letters are found within the place name Xianjang
